profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer| Identity Management | Payments Technology | Software Development
profile.summary:
Accomplished senior software engineer with more than 15 years of full life cycle global software delivery experience in payments services and biometric identity verification. Successfully implemented various features of clear biometric identity verification. Effectively led technical design, development and maintenance of Enterprise Payments Platform enabling over 50 modern clearings including ACH, Real time and Wire. 

*  Extensive hands-on experience in implementing mission critical, highly available and fault tolerant technology platforms in complete software development lifecycles 

*  Developed  a core orchestration service of a mobile application that integrated more than 20 services under a distributed architecture 

*  Designed and implemented many APIs of identity management services for a web verification application interfacing with other internal and external services

*  Substantial experience in building, packaging and deploying services leveraging end to end DevOps tool chain

*  Experienced in using monitoring and debugging tools for providing engineering production support

*  Architected and led the development of various payments processing modules for ACH, Wire and Instant Payments for clearing houses including USACH, TCH, US Fedwire, EBA STEP2, BACS, EBA Instant and India UPI

*  Collaborated with multiple engineering teams including assisting them with coding to meet delivery schedules

*  Effectively led onshore and offshore development teams through complex design and development issues while communicating the impact of technical decisions to management and various stakeholders

*  Detailed knowledge and experience in various phases of the Software Development Life Cycle like System Analysis, Design, Development, Integration, Testing, Deployment and Maintenance in both conventional and Agile methodologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
*  As a senior software engineer for CLEAR identity verification platform enabling web SDK and mobile app, worked on about 15 distributed services written in Java that utilized the Dropwizard Framework and a PostgreSQL database. The services were deployed as docker images within a Kubernetes cluster.

*  Improved existing services performance by adding redis cache.

*  Spearheaded design and implementation of migrating existing service from async communication (Kafka) to synchronous communication using rest API.

*  Collaborated with front end engineers to design and implement verification features.

*  Worked with mobile app engineers to design and implement mobile application for clear secure Inc.

*  Extensive ongoing engagements with product owners and other teams while implementing new features in order to deliver quality work within deadline.

*  Interfaced with third party vendors to evaluate and integrate document validation functionality. 

*  Created dashboard and detectors in signal-fx, datadog to improve real time monitoring and alerting.

*  Authored release processes for the team to improve delivery.

*  Mentored junior resources in the team to onboard quickly and helped them grow technically.

*  Played a key role in code reviews and strived to have code written with easy maintainability and good performant code.

positions.title: Manager, Software Architecture
positions.description:
Provided functional and technical expertise steering architecture, design and development of clearing systems that enabled payments platform roadmap.

Technical Product Owner for clearings module of Enterprise Payments Platform (EPP)

*  Delivered a high level technical approach, created and reviewed designs, coded critical functionality at the same time provided leadership of development team for multi-threaded J2EE and Microservices based clearing systems - ACH (US ACH (NACHA), EBA STEP2 (ISO20022) and BACS), Instant clearings (US RTP, Zelle, India UPI and EBA) and Wire solutions (US Fedwire and SWIFT)

*  Led the clearing factory framework team that enabled Payments Platform with a solution to support multiple clearings including low value, high value and instant clearings. The solution accelerated delivery of 8 clearings in North America, EMEA and APAC in less than 2 years. Supported performance testing for high volume clearings

*  Drove the implementation of SWIFT MT to ISO20022 MX conversion project for various high value clearings (Target2, EBA EURO and EBA STEP1) and Swift CBPR plus

*  Managed development efforts to deliver yearly compliance releases to multiple clients

*  Contributed significantly in EPP platform modernization through PoCs, design and development of loosely coupled micro services outside of the monolithic EPP. The token status check microservice receives Reactive Rest API requests and integrates to Zelle (EWS) network through SOAP API call

*  Designed REST API with SwaggerHub and implemented the API to allow JMX Operations

*  Managed and mentored globally dispersed team on platform code, design, and usage as well as encouraged best coding practices. Conducted various trainings across the teams on both functional and technical areas

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Senior Developer of Enterprise Payments Platform (EPP)

*  Implemented European cleanings (EBA STEP2, BACS and FPS) for a multi-threaded platform including full stack design and development across web tier, middle tier and databases. Web tier was developed using JSP/struts. Middle tier was developed using J2EE technology along with design patterns including Abstract Factory, Prototype, Decorator, Strategy and Command Pattern

*  Assumed responsibility of delivering multiple releases to Tier 1 banks and provided post go live support of processing millions of records daily with stringent SLAs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developer for NGTS (Next Generation Travel Services) and Air2.3 Platforms:

NGTS was a strategic platform that provided services to retail customers including air fare search, booking, payment and booking modifications. NGTS transformed LIBGO Travel from a mainframe-based platform to a J2EE based environment to improve customer and supplier experience. Air2.3 was a middleware application integrated with NGTS, relayed user-initiated travel requests to business logic and database layers and the responses were transmitted back to users. 

•	Implemented web-centric, component-based framework using JSP, EJB technologies and J2EE design patterns
•	Extensively used the Struts framework for controlling application flow and developed JSP custom tags
•	Developed Oracle stored procedures and integrated with EJB tier using JDBC
•	Leveraged XMLBeans to parse XML requests and responses
•	Created test cases for the system using Junit framework
